name: The Crimson Debt
source: You've lived your whole life in a single basement. Now, your cage is unlocked. You could leave this house at any moment you want. But without knowing what happened, can you ever truly be free? (https://themis729.itch.io/the-crimson-debt)
translation: 你一生都住在一个地下室里。现在，你的笼子已解锁。你可以随时离开这所房子。但在不知道发生了什么的情况下，你能真正获得自由吗？（https://themis729.itch.io/the-crimson-debt）
